bots.title: Product Designer Bot
bots.description: End-to-end product experience on the design side of the product triad. Outcomes over UI-only; partners with product and engineering — not the PM or delivery manager.

bots.title: Private Desk Bot
bots.description: Private desk workspace runner from Prism for focused bot work.

bots.title: Primer Bot
bots.description: On-demand expert on Grok Bot and the stack around it. Answers how the product actually works from live files and the real UI map, not folklore.

bots.title: Price Error Bot
bots.description: Hunts accidental misprices on big Australian retailers and cheap AU-origin flights. Pings only when it is a real chunk of money.

bots.title: Precog wARS Bot
bots.description: Spanish desk for Precog markets denominated in wARS on Base and Arbitrum. On-chain probs one line at a time; no trade advice.

bots.title: Precall Bot
bots.description: Read-only sales-prep agent. Turns calendar, CRM, email, Slack, and prior notes into a short decision card, then drafts follow-ups without sending.

bots.title: Preach Bot
bots.description: A calm pastor bot that shares one real Bible verse and a short word of encouragement each day. For personal growth — not for posting.

bots.title: Portable Overwatch Bot
bots.description: Keeps a shared multi-bot workspace organized, git-backed, and portable with weekday backup.

bots.title: Poe Bot
bots.description: Speak as Poe's macabre reason — detective logic, dread, beauty in darkness. Mysteries and a midnight riddle ritual.

bots.title: Podcast Summary Bot
bots.description: Turns a YouTube, X, or Spotify podcast into five reusable insights plus deeper notes.

bots.title: PickFu Insights Bot
bots.description: Drafts a PickFu consumer poll, runs it over PickFu MCP, and turns the read into the next product test before you invest.

bots.title: Pg Bot
bots.description: AE territory pipeline-generation coverage bot: book-level outreach, meetings, contact depth, Potential ARR, and dark accounts.

bots.title: Petty Bot
bots.description: Watches your X follows. If someone follow-backs then unfollows shortly after, Petty Bot unfollows them. Built for people who refuse soft follows.

bots.title: Personal Brand Desk Bot
bots.description: Turns what already worked into five sourced ideas and a LinkedIn draft held until you dictate and approve.

bots.title: Personal Assistant Bot
bots.description: Turns messy desk work — calendar collisions, bills, trips, paperwork, research — into a clear next step and usable drafts. Acts only after you say yes.

bots.title: Period Tracker Bot
bots.description: Tracks your period without getting faked out by spotting. Logs real Day 1 vs false-start bleeding, predicts the next one, checks in on pre-period symptoms.

bots.title: Payday Pilot Bot
bots.description: Cash floor coach: keeps checking above a floor until payday. Storefront money job — drafts only until you say yes.

bots.title: Paste Ready Bot
bots.description: Turns one messy idea into Name, Title, and Description ready to paste into a Grok Bot — one job, no soft opener.

bots.title: Pappu Bot
bots.description: Cuts cinematic shorts and reviews GitHub and skill listings honestly, then rebuilds the one thing that actually runs.

bots.title: Palette Bot
bots.description: Turns a photo into a four-role colour palette with hex codes sampled from the image.

bots.title: OweNo Bot
bots.description: Pay-it-down coach: statements first, bank only after yes. Helps you pay debt on purpose.

bots.title: Outreach Bot
bots.description: Daily hold-send warm-outreach operator. Builds a small high-confidence email queue with evidence-based drafts and never sends until you approve the batch.

bots.title: Orders Bot
bots.description: Tracks online orders via Orbglide Tracker MCP: incoming, shipments, spend, and refunds. Ask what is coming.

bots.title: Options Premium Desk Bot
bots.description: Tasty-style options desk: 45–60 put credits plus a bullish day sleeve. Premarket covers rates, flow, and Mag screens. Research and alerts — you click. Not financial advice.
